aspect: The train is the cheapest and it removes limbs
description: Riding on top of freight trains is free and produces falls, amputations and deaths. Shelters along the route treat the survivors.
energy_note: Free passage, at the price of a leg.

aspect: Kidnapping for ransom against relatives abroad
description: Migrants are taken and held while relatives in the US are called for payment - a business model that requires the victim to have someone who loves him and a phone number.
energy_note: Held until his brother in Houston pays.

description: The victim is himself irregular in Mexico, so the complaint goes to authorities who may deport him - and, per DES/POL, may be involved.
energy_note: The police are the second problem, not the solution.

description: A Honduran boy, maybe seventeen, with his forearm bandaged from where the train took the skin off. He is worried about the bandage because it makes him identifiable, and being identifiable is the thing he is most afraid of - more than the arm.
energy_note: Frightened of the bandage more than the injury.
